_selectionGuidance: Lead with interaction — walking, laughing, looking at each other — rather than a formal facing-camera portrait, since the page explicitly promises chemistry over posed romance. Includes a ring-detail frame and a range from playful (piggyback) to quietly comfortable (lake hug), so camera-shy couples can see themselves here too.
